## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1/2/3/4/5/6 (sprint verifier-fail slice): All 6 loop protocol DDs for sprint verifier-fail touchpoint

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test + edit sprint/SKILL.md — Gate 2)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Edit — verifier-fail loop block)
- tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-sprint-verifier-fail.sh (Create)

## Loop Block Requirements
Inline block adjacent to f63c re-dispatch block. Key distinction vs other touchpoints: REPLAN_ESCALATE upstream is read DYNAMICALLY from the planner's escalation_upstream field (not hardcoded). All other elements same: cycle declaration, oscillation-check hard gate on cycle >= 2, HALT-vs-REPLAN exclusivity, PROTOCOL_ERROR on invariant violation, See: pointer.

## Non-Regression
After edit, re-run both prior fixtures: 
- bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → PASS
- bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh → PASS

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-sprint-verifier-fail.sh exists and is executable
2. grep -q 'Current cycle: N of MAX_CYCLES' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → found
3. grep -q 'See:.*protocol' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → found
4. grep -q 'escalation_upstream' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md → found (dynamic upstream source)
5. dd-2 fixture asserts REPLAN_ESCALATE upstream changes when synthetic planner artifact escalation_upstream field varies
6. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-sprint-verifier-fail.sh → PASS
7. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → PASS (non-regression)
8. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-implplan-steps.sh → PASS (non-regression)
